record: model-cost-pi-migration / the representative efficiency sequences of the model-cost common path, sampled by scripts/efficiency-baseline.ts under the label takeover-g

run.label: takeover-g
run.temporaryRootsNote: created for this run and removed when it ended; every storage root was isolated under them

sequences.name: main-request
sequences.title: 主请求：初始化 + 一次主会话请求 + 轮结束保存

invariants.name: the initialization read the baseline and the estimate, and published nothing
the initialization asked the provider once and the second source not at all
the request itself asked no provider: the reading was inside its success TTL
the Round's end committed through one read, one lock and one publish
the request was priced at its own start, by this file's arithmetic
the session's startup snapshot is the model and level it began with

comparability.note: the common path (framework binding + model-cost shared logic + the production frontend composition): re-run this entry on the unified implementation and compare the same windows.

sequences.name: multi-turn
sequences.title: 多 Turn：一轮内五次请求，轮结束才保存

invariants.name: five Turns cost the storage root nothing at all
five Turns asked the provider nothing
the whole Round committed through exactly one publish
the five requests were accumulated once each, at this file's arithmetic

comparability.note: the common path (framework binding + model-cost shared logic + the production frontend composition): re-run this entry on the unified implementation and compare the same windows.

sequences.name: main-child-concurrency
sequences.title: 主子并发：主会话 + 两个子代理 + 一个孙会话，各轮独立保存

invariants.name: the process asked the provider once at startup and once more when its stated clock passed the reading's success TTL
invariants.detail: requests=2 (one startup prefetch, one settled-request refresh due 360000ms after the reading) paths=/user/balance,/user/balance

invariants.name: each session's own Round end published one record
invariants.detail: publishes=4 reads=5 (one initialization load plus one inside each of the four commits) lockOperations=28

invariants.name: a subagent's consumption is its own, and the parent's own record excludes it
invariants.detail: main=0.06 (two requests of its own) childA=0.03 grand=0.03

invariants.name: the token-only channel's request carries tokens and no monetary amount
the direct parent chains are what the host reported, not by name or depth
the child's own Round's interval was recorded on its session

comparability.note: the common path (framework binding + model-cost shared logic + the production frontend composition): re-run this entry on the unified implementation and compare the same windows. Its native half in a real host — the spawned session's own binding, the native disposal — is driven here as semantic facts, and a comparison of that half belongs to the real-host dock runs ticket 22 owns.

the save cost one coordinated read-modify-publish after the initialization's own load

invariants.name: the other harness's record survived the save unchanged

invariants.name: the whole read-only refresh cost the storage root nothing
the whole read-only refresh asked the provider nothing
the refresh did not commit the request that was still uncommitted

notComparableScenarios.name: native-adapter-fact-mapping
notComparableScenarios.reason: the OMP adapter's own native reads (Turn, Round, rename, startup model, context, provider access) are host code this in-process driver replaces with semantic deliveries; their cost is the host's, and the real-host numbers belong to the dock runs ticket 22 owns.

notComparableScenarios.name: omp-viewed-session-display
notComparableScenarios.reason: the OMP viewed-session path is an OMP-only display fact (pi keeps its own session's display), so a comparison has no shared behaviour to compare.

notComparableScenarios.name: real-terminal-drawing
notComparableScenarios.reason: the widget's real drawing, its widths and its layout are the human acceptance check (P52); this entry measures drawings, not terminal rendering.

notComparableScenarios.name: native-session-storage
notComparableScenarios.reason: the host's own session JSONL and logs are outside the storage root this baseline attributes costs to.

notComparableScenarios.name: codex-account-query
notComparableScenarios.reason: the account query's own endpoint needs a real credential and its proxy entry; this baseline holds no access to that provider, so its request count is an absence, not a cost.

notComparableScenarios.name: external-document-adoption-refresh
notComparableScenarios.reason: adopting another writer's committed document on a read refresh has no implementation on either harness at this baseline; only the read-only work's own cost is recorded.
